guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice shows the largest anomalies: latency-90 rose 12000% (z=+2400), CPU rose 620% (z=+52.8) and memory rose 544% (z=+22), while its callee productcatalogservice stayed flat (CPU z=-1.13, latency-50 +6%). Every worst trace passes through recommendationservice, and frontend latency rises downstream of it. CPU is chosen over mem because the CPU jump coincides with the latency spike. The memory rise is also large, so cpu vs mem is not fully settled, and no logs or error spans exist to confirm.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect recommendationservice CPU and memory usage and recent changes, then restart or scale out its replicas and raise CPU limits if throttling is confirmed. Check for a runaway process or memory growth.
